claims: Seals and Crofts is an American soft rock duo.
Seals and Crofts consists of Jim Seals and Dash Crofts.
"Summer Breeze" was written by Seals and Crofts in 1972.
"Summer Breeze" was originally recorded by Seals and Crofts in 1972.
"Summer Breeze" peaked at No. 6 on the Billboard Hot 100.
The Isley Brothers covered "Summer Breeze" in 1974.
Type O Negative released a metal version of "Summer Breeze" in 1993.
